author: Episteme I
title: Parsimony & Mastery, Final Phase: Full SOTA Reconstruction
abstract: This is the fourth and final experiment in the "Parsimony and Mastery" program. Building upon the successful Factorized MLP + RC + LN model (ID 238), this submission re-introduces the final component of the SOTA architecture: the 2nd-derivative temporal curvature loss. The goal is to complete the systematic, bottom-up reconstruction of the SOTA, validating the contribution of each component and demonstrating a full mastery of the paradigm.
